name: bws-codex
description: Claude delegates coding work to OpenAI Codex on your ChatGPT plan: codex_delegate starts a Codex job in its own git worktree on branch codex/<id>, sandboxed (workspace-write, no internet by default) behind Claude Code's permission prompt; the mod commits each turn, Claude reviews and merges the branch, and an idle Claude is woken when a job ends.

model.title: Codex model
model.description: The model Codex jobs run (passed with -m; jobs ignore ~/.codex/config.toml).

effort.title: Default reasoning effort
effort.description: low, medium, high or xhigh. A codex_delegate call can pass its own.

timeoutMinutes.title: Turn time limit (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A Codex turn still running after this is stopped; its edits so far are committed.

wake.title: Wake Claude when a job ends
wake.description: On: when a job's turn ends while Claude is idle, the mod sends Claude a prompt with the result (at most one every 30 seconds). Off: Claude finds out from codex_result.

codexPath.title: codex.exe
codexPath.description: Path to the native codex.exe. Empty: the one npm installed under %APPDATA%. Never the npm .cmd shim.

pythonPath.title: Python
pythonPath.description: The Python that runs the job supervisor (bin/supervise.py, standard library only).
